hypothesis: Under one pre-registered 20000-step cosine trajectory initialized from the fixed C58 parent, the s20000 endpoint will improve both held-out action error and paired LIBERO success over its own s10000 checkpoint without losing gripper, language, visual, or suite safety; if it does not, insufficient optimizer steps are not a supported explanation for C60's failure under this tested contract.
single_variable: Within the C67 trajectory, compare the frozen s10000 checkpoint with the frozen s20000 checkpoint; architecture, C58 initialization, frozen INT8 H3, FACT/FastWAM source, four data streams and hashes, 4/2/1/1 rank mixture, seed, losses, optimizer hyperparameters, 20000-step scheduler, checkpoint cadence, held-out samples, rollout states, action solver and deployment contract are identical. The only endpoint difference is 10000 additional optimizer steps and their deterministically sampled 80000 examples.
parent_baseline: Both C67 endpoints descend from promoted C58B s10000 SHA256 2e6294712f7944037c3982ae7e6b8b87adbdaab190e1972ff4a3d592cc99e541. C67-s10000 is the sole matched budget control; historical C60-s10000 SHA256 d6659c6b387f062a99f670a1d902b56df71a6bf1472aa4e46e56c9213ba75a36 is an external anchor only because it used a different 10000-step cosine trajectory ending at LR=0.

references.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
C56b online frozen-H3 FACT port plus C67 budget-only execution contract
references.revision: content hashes frozen in the manually issued C67 release marker

architecture.field: frozen online H3 and thirty shared FACT action/consequence blocks
architecture.paper: FACT trains action, future-image, future-state and value objectives through one causal video-transformer backbone.
architecture.upstream_code: Official FACT executes the shared Wan causal transformer online and masks failed action imitation while retaining consequence supervision.
architecture.local: C67 preserves C60 exactly: pinned INT8 H3 executes online without gradients and all thirty trainable ActionDiT/FACT blocks receive layer-aligned H3 K/V.
architecture.rationale: H3 replaces Wan and remains frozen INT8, so this is the already-audited H3 backbone port rather than a FACT reproduction; C67 changes no architecture relative to C60.

data.paper: FACT mixes expert and failure episodes, with failure actions masked.
data.upstream_code: EpisodeMixtureSampler selects dataset, episode and frame; training mixes expert, success and failure supervision.
data.local: Every absolute step and rank deterministically select 4 expert, 2 success-rollout, 1 observational-failure and 1 causal-failure row using the unchanged seed and immutable C60 hashes. C67-s20 contains the exact C67-s10 sample prefix plus 80000 later samples.
data.rationale: The LIBERO stream implementation differs from RoboTwin storage, but the official episode-mixture and failure-mask semantics are retained and C67 introduces no data change.

action.field: LIBERO absolute 7D horizon32 shifted-flow action contract
action.paper: World-action training must preserve the deployed action representation and exclude failure actions from imitation.
action.upstream_code: FACT uses an explicit action mask; FastWAM generates action chunks with shifted flow matching.
action.local: Both endpoints use the same audited horizon32 absolute 7D targets, proprio8, shift5, target normalization, failure masks, ten-step solver, gripper conversion and replan8 deployment.
action.rationale: LIBERO absolute 7D horizon32 replaces RoboTwin delta14 horizon48 while preserving the fixed deployed C58/C60 action contract.

objective.paper: Action, future image, future state and value flow objectives jointly train the world-action backbone.
objective.upstream_code: wa_casual_trainer.py applies the four objectives and the failure action mask.
objective.local: Both endpoints use identical action/future-H3/future-state/value weights, masks and train-only 7168D future-H3 whitening; no future target enters action inference.
objective.rationale: Frozen H3 K/V replaces Wan VAE targets and uses an empirically frozen train-only normalization; C67 retains the already-audited port without an objective patch.

optimization.field: single 20000-step trajectory with an internal s10000 control
optimization.paper: Long distributed training uses separate parameter groups and a declared schedule.
optimization.upstream_code: FACT uses distributed optimization and separate backbone/action parameter groups.
optimization.local: Fresh initialization from the same fixed C58 parent, eight A800 ranks, global batch8, AdamW base/action LR 2e-5/2e-4, warmup500 and cosine horizon20000 are fixed from step0. Every 1000-step segment is saved and independently restored; s10000 is not selected post hoc and s20000 is the sole treatment endpoint.
evidence: C56b ten-step optimizer and strict-restore canary in experiments/dossiers/h3_c56b_fact_online_v1.json
optimization.rationale: Exact numeric LR and horizon are H3/LIBERO port hyperparameters. Starting a fresh 20k schedule avoids pretending the historical C60 LR=0 checkpoint can be resumed under an unchanged contract.

evaluation.field: pre-registered offline bridge and paired closed-loop budget effect
evaluation.paper: Closed-loop task success is decisive; training loss alone cannot establish effectiveness.
evaluation.upstream_code: Action generation is evaluated independently of consequence/value training loss.
evaluation.local: All 20 milestones receive fixed balanced80 diagnostics. Only pre-registered s10000 and s20000 may enter a paired 680-state LIBERO comparison, with identical fresh-process and initial-state rules. Historical C60 is an external anchor and never substitutes for the internal control.
evaluation.rationale: LIBERO replaces RoboTwin; matched endpoints and effect thresholds are frozen before any C67 checkpoint exists. Reused historical states make this a budget diagnostic, not a fresh benchmark promotion.

evidence: FACT 618a6c16868699b6d4138941de6a863589ac00dd and FastWAM 45d8e1458921d83f8ad6cf9ce993d371208dabd0 are fixed; the launcher additionally requires execution-file hashes in a manual release marker.
C67 reuses the audited C60 architecture unchanged; the real eight-rank canary executed frozen online INT8 H3 and all thirty shared blocks.
The 218125-window four-stream C60 dataset identity, episode-then-frame sampler and seed20260816 are frozen; no H3 K/V cache is a dataset field.
Horizon32 absolute7D, proprio8, shift5, masks, normalization and deploy conversion are unchanged and round-trip tested.
The audited 10:1:0.4:0.4 FACT objective, train-only target normalization and zero future-target-to-action leakage are unchanged.
The existing trainer accepts scheduler_horizon=20000 as a checkpoint identity field; C67 launches a fresh trajectory, fixes 20 milestones and refuses any pre-existing output.
s10000 control, s20000 treatment, balanced80 bridge metrics, paired 680-state thresholds and claim boundary are pre-registered in docs/C67_C60_BUDGET_ABLATION_2026-08-17.md.
C60's real canary recorded positive finite gradients in all thirty shared blocks at every step and no gradient into frozen H3; C67 changes only schedule length.
The identical C60 model/data/objective topology completed the real 10-step eight-A800 canary and 10000-step trajectory with finite losses.
The existing 12.2GB full-state checkpoint restored model, optimizer and scheduler with prediction max_abs=0; C67 repeats this gate every 1000 steps.
The sole initialization is C58B s10000 SHA256 2e6294712f7944037c3982ae7e6b8b87adbdaab190e1972ff4a3d592cc99e541; launcher release must bind the same READY and bytes.
Historical C60 balanced80 was mixed and failed its continuation gate; C67 s10/s20 evidence does not exist yet.
No C67 checkpoint or rollout exists; no effectiveness claim is permitted.

budget.rank_mixture: 4 expert_demo + 2 success_rollout + 1 observational_failure + 1 causal_failure per optimizer step
budget.estimated_hours_note: Linear steady-optimizer estimate from measured C60 4.41h/10000 only; checkpoint I/O and evaluation are additional, and ETA must be re-estimated after s1000.

decision.rationale: This is a bounded diagnostic that reuses a proven topology and changes only the pre-registered optimization horizon/budget. It is methodologically launchable, but this repository intentionally creates no release marker and starts no GPU process in this change.
decision.launch_command: After independent review creates a hash-bound GO_C67_BUDGET_ABLATION_20K release JSON: C67_RELEASE_FILE=/path/to/manual-release.json bash scripts/h3wam/launch_c67_c60_budget_ablation_20k_8gpu.sh
